title: BHMarketer Trustpilot Removal FAQ Generator: Trustpilot Review Eligibility Scoring and FAQ Schema Generation
description: The BHMarketer Trustpilot Removal FAQ Generator checks a Trustpilot review against the five reasons Trustpilot accepts when a business reports a review (harmful or illegal, personal information, advertising or promotional, not based on a genuine experience, about a different business), scores removal eligibility from 0 to 100, lists the evidence to include, and generates a tailored Trustpilot review removal FAQ as text, Markdown, JSON, FAQPage JSON-LD or HTML. Includes identical TypeScript (NPM) and Python (PyPI) implementations, a 25-entry FAQ knowledge base and a 20-case benchmark dataset. Estimates only; Trustpilot makes the final decision. Not affiliated with Trustpilot. Built by BHMarketer.ai.
